examples.problem_statement: Multiply 38 × 14 using Urdhva Tiryagbhyam (vertically and crosswise)

solution.operation: Write the numbers one above the other
solution.description: Urdhva works digit-position by digit-position, right to left

solution.operation: Vertical product of the units digits
solution.description: The units digit of the answer comes from the units column alone
Crosswise means tens of the top number times units of the bottom, plus units of the top times tens of the bottom; the tens column collects both pairs plus any carry

solution.operation: Vertical product of the leading digits, plus the carry
solution.description: This is the leftmost column, so its whole value is written down rather than carried further

solution.operation: Read the digits off left to right
solution.description: Assembling the column digits with their carries gives the product

common_mistakes: adding only one crosswise product instead of both
dropping the carry from the units column into the crosswise step
